country.name: India

publisher.name: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice (Government of India)

default_in_force_rule.text: Constitution of India art. 394: the Constitution came into force on 26 January 1950. This record holds one version, the text as brought up to date by the Legislative Department on 1 May 2024, so no per-amendment in-force days are derived.

country.licence_note: Text of the Constitution of India (as on 1 May 2024), published by the Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India (legislative.gov.in). Government of India works are published for public use; see https://legislative.gov.in.

sources.name: The Constitution of India, as on 1st May, 2024 (Legislative Department, Official Languages Wing)
sources.notes: Pocket edition in diglot form, brought up to date to the Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023. The English text layer of the PDF was read; no OCR.

versions.note: The text as on 1 May 2024, incorporating every amendment up to the Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth) Amendment Act, 2023, as the Legislative Department published it.

decisions: One version only: the official PDF gives the text as on 1 May 2024 and no earlier consolidated text, so this is the oldest version available (first_law null), dated from the publication date on the PDF's own cover.
The Preamble and Articles 1 to 395 are included. The Schedules, Appendices and amendment footnotes are left out of this first build.
Amendment footnote markers (N[ ... ] and N***) are removed from the text; omitted articles remain as units carrying their own 'Omitted' note.
Part and chapter headings between articles are not kept as units in this first build.
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Sonnet 5.5) wrote the parser. No model wrote, edited or summarised legal text.
